================================================================================
A meta command with no argument
================================================================================

\q

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (meta_command
    (command_name)))

================================================================================
Meta commands on one line
================================================================================

 \v \p

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (meta_command
    (command_name))
  (meta_command
    (command_name)))

Arguments
================================================================================

 \v   foo   bar  \p   zz

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (meta_command

    (word)
    (word))

    (word)))
